data_fields.name: clip_frame_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: frame rate per animation; move = max(1, floor(min ms per px))

best_idea: A clip should be a clock with an explicit skip rule and an explicit finish-now-or-play-out call, so a hit can cut a recovery clip to its last pose without the animation and the duel state drifting apart.
decision_why: Take the clock, skip rule and finish call; reject the UI-only parts and keep the duel's own clock for anything that decides damage or timing.
acceptance: When a server-confirmed hit stops a hero's recovery clip, the hero either snaps to the clip's last pose in one frame or finishes the clip, as set by clip data; a test asserts the clip reaches its final frame and the duel state is never read from the clip.
